ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central surface) to low-intensity black pixels (trailing margins and tips).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white surface across both lobes. Continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge. Four distinct, isolated dark circular focal spots: one on the mid-left lobe, one near the central notch area, and two on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a wide-angle vertex and shallow depth relative to the overall lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes with prominent jagged peaks and deep vertical indentations (10-25 pixel amplitude) along the interior margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve starting from the peduncle attachment, terminating in distinct upward-curving, tapered black tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four localized dark pixel clusters on the white ventral surface, roughly circular in morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged indentations and irregular tearing visible along the trailing edge contour, particularly on the inner half of both lobes.
